turns.prompt_text: What kind of grasshopper is this Attached 1 file. - image.png
turns.response_html:
It looks like you might have accidentally uploaded a screenshot of your phone's home screen instead of a photo of the grasshopper!

While I can see you've got some great apps for mindfulness and gaming—like Forest Island and Finch—there isn't a grasshopper in this specific image.

If you can upload the photo of the insect, I can help you identify it. Different regions host a vast variety of species, from the common Differential Grasshopper to the more striking Lubbers. Perspectives from entomologists and nature enthusiasts often highlight how these insects play vital roles in ecosystems across every continent (except Antarctica).

Would you like to try uploading the photo of the grasshopper again?
